operations.label: Address branch: same-as-employee vs manual address
operations.summary: wantsSameAddress = contact.sameAddressAsEmployee || !contact.address. True → check sameAddress checkbox only. False → uncheck + open Edit Address modal + fill fields + OK.

operations.label: Gate: skip add+save if oath already exists
operations.summary: If ctx.alreadyHasOath=true: all remaining plan ops (addNewOathLink, oathDateInput, oathOkButton, saveButton) are skipped via early-return guards. Handler then calls ctx.updateData({ status: 'Skipped (Existing Oath)' }) and returns without error.

operations.label: Gate: skip if not full mode or signerItemIds already set
operations.summary: needsApprovalWait = mode==='full' && signerItemIds.length===0; if false → ctx.skipStep('wait-approval')

operations.label: Delegated: stamp approved records onto ctx (approve path)
operations.summary: ctx.updateData({ records, recordCount, fannedOutItemIds, fannedOutCount }) so the kernel's terminal done row carries the approved record set. Actual fan-out (approveTo per-record + approveDocumentTo once-per-PDF) is handled by the /api/ocr/approve-batch HTTP route outside this handler.
operations.note: Delegated + approved path only.

operations.label: Assert every expected signer outcome is 'done'
operations.summary: Builds byItem map; any expectedItemId missing or status!='done' → throw with itemId=status list; no HR ticket is filed

operations.label: Fail loud if any required keyword is still blank
operations.summary: Throws with the list of missing keyword labels if missing.length > 0 — never allows import of an incompletely-keyed document
operations.note: Required keyword labels: UCPath ID, Last Name, First Name, Document Name, Department Name, Department Code, Vice Chancellor, Vice Chancellor Code

operations.label: Deferred UCPath login (Duo MFA)
operations.summary: loginToUCPath(page, ctx.workflowInstance, ctx.signal) — deferred from session-launch; first item triggers Duo, subsequent items reuse warm session. Throws on auth failure.

operations.label: Await Duo MFA Approval (×3)
operations.summary: Waits for Duo approval on each system; all three pend concurrently — operator approves in any order

operations.label: Build lookup targets list
operations.summary: Filters records to those needing a lookup (needsLookup='name'|'verify'|'verify-only'). Generates itemIds (ocrChildItemIdPrefix-runId-rN). Applies LLM suggestion EIDs as verify-only lookup targets when present.

operations.label: Carry-forward resolved fields from previous run (reupload)
operations.summary: When input.previousRunId is set, reads the prior OCR row's records and calls applyCarryForward to merge already-resolved fields (EID, matchState) onto v2 re-extracted records via Levenshtein key match.
operations.note: Optional — only on reupload.

operations.label: Clear resolved fields on selected records
operations.summary: For each recordIndex: clears employeeId (flat or nested employee.employeeId), sets matchState=lookup-pending, matchSource=null, matchConfidence=null, verification=null, forceResearch=true.

operations.label: Compute failedPages, emptyPages, pageStatusSummary
operations.summary: Derives failedPages (OCR failed on page), emptyPages (OCR succeeded but produced zero records), and summary counts from ocrResult.pages.

operations.label: Branch: crm-only path requires UCPath EID re-query
operations.summary: !isEidInput(input) && crmMatch === 'crm-only': must fetch UCPath results by the CRM-sourced EID because UCPath returned 0 SDCMP rows in searching. All other paths (eid-input, direct/date/none CRM matches) use sdcmpFromSearch already fetched.

operations.label: ctx.retry: wrap doReportFlow with 2 attempts and 3s linear backoff
operations.summary: On first attempt failure logs 'Retrying Reports navigation (attempt 2)'; both failures mark success=false and fall through to tracker write

operations.label: Date Reconciliation (post-kronos)
operations.summary: lastDayWorked = timecard.lastPunchDate ?? kualiData.lastDayWorked; separationDate = kronosSkipped ? kualiData.separationDate : computeSeparationDate(LDW, sick, holiday); termEffDate = sep+1
operations.note: Pure computation. kronosSkipped → Kuali sep date kept VERBATIM (no 'per Kronos' comment). Derived when kronos ran (even if no punch returned)

operations.label: Fan-out to person-lookup via delegateToAllImpl
operations.summary: Calls delegateToAllImpl({ child: personLookupWorkflow, inputs, fireAndForget:true, deriveItemId, rootTracePrefix, daemonFlags }). Each child is a delegated single row under the OCR runId.
operations.note: Per-record: name-kind → {name}, verify/verify-only → {emplId, keepNonHdh:true}.

operations.label: Delegated: emit running step=awaiting-approval snapshot
operations.summary: Emits running step=awaiting-approval snapshot carrying all records + failedPages/emptyPages. Dashboard OcrReviewPane shows Approve/Discard controls.
operations.note: Delegated branch only.

operations.label: Delegate to Person Lookup by Name
operations.summary: ctx.delegateTo(personLookupWorkflow, { name }) on different/not-found tiers; resolved EID replaces kualiData.eid and triggers Job Summary re-fetch
operations.note: On EID correction: re-fetches Job Summary with verified EID (critical for correct dept/payroll). No New Kronos re-search needed (kronos-search runs after with corrected EID)

operations.label: Derive active/HDH status from results
operations.summary: resolveActiveStatusResultsForPersonLookup → deriveActiveCheckOutcome: produces activeStatus (active|inactive|not-found|non-hdh|ambiguous), isActive, isHdhAccepted, terminationDate, terminationReason (blanked when active), expectedJobEndDate, candidateEids, startDate (UCPath), effdt

operations.label: Derive PDF sha256 hash
operations.summary: pdfHash = input.pdfHash ?? registered.sha256 ?? hashFile(storagePath).sha256; fail-safe — warns and returns undefined on error

operations.label: Disambiguate ambiguous roster candidates via LLM
operations.summary: For records left lookup-pending with rosterCandidates (and not form-eid or manual), calls disambiguateMatch concurrently (up to OCR_DISAMBIG_CONCURRENCY=4). Applies spec.applyDisambiguation with the chosen EID/confidence.
operations.note: Optional — only when at least one ambiguous record exists.

operations.label: Delegated: throw OcrDiscardedError on discard
operations.summary: OcrDiscardedError propagates to the kernel → terminal failed row. The discard HTTP route (/api/ocr/discard-prepare) also writes its own failed step=discarded row and cascade-cancels queued child tasks.
operations.note: Delegated + discarded path only.

operations.label: Dry-run gate: skip UCPath mutation when dryRun=true
operations.summary: If input.dryRun: capture screenshot 'onboarding-dry-run-before-submit', stamp status:'Dry Run Complete' + dryRun:true, return early before buildTransactionPlan().execute(). All upstream steps (CRM, person-search, I9) already ran.

operations.label: Gate: skip Save if dryRun mode
operations.summary: shouldCommitOathSignature = !dryRun && !alreadyHasOath. If dryRun: call options.beforeCommit() (captures dry-run screenshot), log 'Dry run: skipped UCPath Save', set ctx.updateData({ status: 'Dry Run Complete', dryRunProofCaptured: 'true' }). Branches to Return-to-Search without clicking Save.
operations.note: Conditional: only evaluated when ctx.alreadyHasOath=false.

operations.label: Branch: dry run — screenshot and return without importing
operations.summary: If input.dryRun=true: takes a form screenshot (label: onbase-dry-run-pre-import), sets status='Dry Run Complete', returns early — Import button is never clicked
operations.note: dryRun is set by the OCR fan-out (OnbaseInput.dryRun). Dry run still walks the full form including keyset autofill + keyword verification.

operations.label: Dry-run gate: skip submit if dryRun=true
operations.summary: dryRun → screenshot hr-inquiry-dry-run-pre-submit, ctx.updateData({ticketNumber:'DRY RUN - not submitted', status:'dry-run-complete'}), return early

operations.label: Duplicate contact guard (Levenshtein match)
operations.summary: pickBestContactMatch on normalised names. distance=0 (exact) → sets skipped=true, skips fill-form+save. distance 1-2 (fuzzy) → demote existing primary (if !dryRun) + re-navigate. distance>2 or null → add normally.

operations.label: Branch: EID input vs name input
operations.summary: isEidInput(input): EID path fills emplIdInput + skips CRM EID-disambiguation; name path fills lastNameInput+nameInput with multi-attempt strategy + applies HDH dept filter

operations.label: Branch: EID input (searchCrmByEidOrName) vs name input (searchCrmByName)
operations.summary: isEidInput(input) → searchCrmByEidOrName({ emplId, lastName:resolvedName.lastName, firstName:resolvedName.firstName }); else → searchCrmByName(parsedLastName, parsedFirst)

operations.label: Emit running step=loading-roster
operations.summary: Writes running row with step=loading-roster so session drawer advances.

operations.label: Emit pending tracker row
operations.summary: Writes the initial pending OCR row to JSONL with formType, pdfPath, pdfOriginalName, sessionId, rosterMode.

operations.label: Emit placeholder snapshot with blank records
operations.summary: Emits running step=ocr snapshot with one form-spec-shaped placeholder record per rendered page (spec.placeholderFields). Dashboard Preview tab shows blank inputs immediately.

operations.label: Emit snapshot after lookups complete
operations.summary: Emits running step=person-lookup snapshot with fully-patched records.

operations.label: Emit snapshot post-matching
operations.summary: Emits running step=ocr snapshot with post-match records (badges + EIDs where roster auto-accepted).

operations.label: Emit snapshot with OCR-extracted records (pre-match)
operations.summary: Emits running step=ocr snapshot carrying raw extracted records so Preview tab shows extracted names/dates before matching runs.

operations.label: Emit snapshot before person-lookup fan-out
operations.summary: Emits running step=person-lookup snapshot if there are lookup targets, so Preview keeps showing current records while fan-out runs.

operations.label: spec.enrichRecords hook (verify form only)
operations.summary: Awaits spec.enrichRecords for bespoke enrichment. verify form fans out to person-lookup (CRM employment/oath dates, active status) and i9-lookup (authorized-official signer) via delegateToAllImpl + watchChildRuns, then patches records with applyPersonLookupToVerifyRecord / applyI9ToVerifyRecord.
operations.note: Optional — only when spec.enrichRecords is declared (verify form only for current specs).

operations.label: Existing Transaction Short-Circuit
operations.summary: If findExistingTerminationTransaction returns a T#: persist to ctx.data, screenshot, return without submit
operations.note: alreadyAtSmartHR=true skips re-navigation saving ~12s per doc

operations.label: Query tracker for prior HRC ticket matching sessionId/pdfHash
operations.summary: findPriorTicketForSession(sessionId, pdfHash, trackerDir) — controlDb item index + JSONL lookback (7 days); returns HRC ticket string or null

operations.label: OCR prep failure → throw, no ticket filed
operations.summary: OcrApprovalFailedError → throw Error('oath-upload: OCR prep failed — NOT filing the HR ticket')

operations.label: Discard → CancelledError (not workflow failure)
operations.summary: OcrDiscardedError → throw Object.assign(new CancelledError('discarded'), { cause: err }) so the terminal row classifies on the Cancel surface

operations.label: Detect historical (paper) I-9 redirect
operations.summary: page.url().includes('/form-I9-historical/') → return status:historical (paper import; no electronic Section 2 audit row exists)

operations.label: Branch: duplicate employee dialog vs OK confirmation after Save
operations.summary: If profile.duplicateDialog visible: click duplicateFirstRow, click viewEditSelectedButton, wait **/employee/profile/*, extract profileId from URL, navigate with ?saveAndContinue=true param. Elif profile.okButtonFirst visible: click OK, wait URL, extract profileId. Else: return I9Result error.

operations.label: Branch: existing I9 profile found vs create new
operations.summary: If searchResults.length > 0 and profileId present: press Escape, use existing profileId, skip creation flow. Else: press Escape + waitForTimeout(500), proceed to dashboard.createNewI9Link.

operations.label: Identity Check Name-Tier Branch
operations.summary: classifyNameSimilarity(kualiName, jobSummaryName) → same→skipStep, similar→correct name, different/not-found→delegate to person-lookup
operations.note: same: EID trusted, no action. similar (e.g. Jaden→Jayden): trust EID, write corrected name to Kuali draft. different/not-found: delegate by name. not-found + complete 8-digit EID: FAIL LOUD

operations.label: Gate: skip step unless includeCrmDates === true
operations.summary: ctx.skipStep('crm-dates') when input.includeCrmDates !== true; step is always declared so the step list is consistent across all runs

operations.label: Press Tab to fire Employee Lookup keyset autofill
operations.summary: page.keyboard.press('Tab') after filling UCPath ID — triggers OnBase to autofill all keyword fields from the Employee Lookup keyset

operations.label: Branch: if keyset did not autofill, fill fallback keyword values from OCR data
operations.summary: If keysetAutofilled=false: iterates fallbackKeywordValues(input) and fills each non-empty value via fillKeyword. Combobox keywords (Department Name/Code, Vice Chancellor/Code) use keywordCombobox; all others use keywordInput.
operations.note: Fallback data comes from OCR extraction. Executed only when keyset returns nothing (bad/unknown UCPath ID).

operations.label: Branch: skip CRM name extraction if folder path already known
operations.summary: Known if input.folderPath set OR (input.firstName && input.lastName). Dashboard runs (email/EID only) always take the extraction branch.
operations.note: When knownFolder is set: download was already into finalFolder; temp-rename and extractNameForFolder are both skipped. extractNameForFolder failure is a soft error — log.warn + fallback '<query> EID' folder, run never fails.

operations.label: Department Gate (HDH vs non-HDH)
operations.summary: isAcceptedHdhDepartment(departmentDescription) → HDH: run timecard; non-HDH: skipStep (dates fall back to Kuali verbatim, no timecard comment). FAIL-SAFE: unknown/empty dept still runs
operations.note: Keyword match on 'housing'/'dining'/'hospitality' — not a single dept-code. Only skips on POSITIVE non-HDH determination

operations.label: Kronos Found/Not-Found Branch
operations.summary: Not found → return empty timecard (found:false), handler falls back to Kuali LDW. Found but Go-To fails → THROW (non-fatal in settled parallel, visible in log). Wrong-person timecard → THROW (same semantics).
operations.note: A genuine not-found is best-effort quiet; a mechanical failure (found but can't open) is loud. Non-fatal because New Kronos runs in ctx.parallel settled block

operations.label: Load and precompute roster from disk
operations.summary: Reads the XLSX/CSV roster file from resolvedRosterPath, precomputes match structures. Skipped (empty roster) when rosterMode='optional' and no path resolved.

operations.label: Deferred login to OnBase (SSO + Duo)
operations.summary: Calls loginToOnBase(page) — idempotent UCSD Shibboleth SSO + Duo auth; deferAuth:true means the daemon Duos once here after OCR approval, not at fan-out enqueue time
operations.note: authSteps:false suppresses kernel auto-auth; loginToOnBase is called explicitly in this step. Throws if authentication fails.

operations.label: Call loginToUCPath (idempotent UCPath + Duo MFA)
operations.summary: loginToUCPath(page, undefined, ctx.signal). Returns ok boolean; throws 'UCPath authentication failed' on false. Duo MFA fires only on first item per daemon session.

operations.label: Branch: person lookup or i9 lookup
operations.summary: input.lookup==='person' → runPersonRelookup (personLookupWorkflow). input.lookup==='i9' → runI9Relookup (i9LookupWorkflow); guards that record.formKind==='oath'.

operations.label: Compute LLM lookup suggestions for unmatched records
operations.summary: For records still lookup-pending with needsLookup='name' and no rosterCandidates, calls suggestLookupCandidates (LLM). Suggestions may include an EID hint that becomes a verify-only lookup target.
operations.note: Optional — only when unmatched-by-roster name-lookup records exist.

operations.label: Match each record against roster (spec.matchRecord)
operations.summary: Calls spec.matchRecord({ record, roster }) for each extracted record in parallel. Sets matchState, matchSource, matchConfidence, rosterCandidates.

operations.label: Match CRM records against UCPath SDCMP candidates (name-path)
operations.summary: matchCrmEid(sdcmp, crmRecords): (1) direct: CRM ucpathEmployeeId === any SDCMP emplId → crmMatch:'direct'; (2) date: CRM firstDayOfService within ±7 days of UCPath startDate/effectiveDate → crmMatch:'date'; (3) none: CRM records found but no match → crmMatch:'none'. crm-only: crmMatch='crm-only' set earlier when UCPath had 0 SDCMP but CRM had an EID.
operations.note: Name path only; EID path stamps startDate+payrollTitle without EID matching

operations.label: Parallel-Staggered Auth (3 systems)
operations.summary: Orchestrates prepareLogin (parallel fill) then staggered submit for Kuali, New Kronos, UCPath; each system's Duo is awaited independently
operations.note: All 3 Duos can overlap; operator approves in any order

operations.label: Patch targeted record from lookup outcome
operations.summary: Person: patchOcrRecordFromEidLookupOutcome + applyPersonLookupToVerifyRecord (CRM dates, active status). I9: applyI9ToVerifyRecord (authorized-official signer). patchOcrRecordUnresolved on timeout.

operations.label: Patch records from lookup outcomes
operations.summary: patchOcrRecordFromEidLookupOutcome(records, idx, outcome, 'name') for each byItemId result. patchOcrRecordUnresolved for missingItemIds.

operations.label: Patch new records from lookup outcomes
operations.summary: patchOcrRecordFromEidLookupOutcome for each outcome by kind. patchUnresolved for missing outcomes (no result within timeout). Handles name and verify-only kinds.

operations.label: Branch: rehire short-circuit vs proceed to I9 and transaction
operations.summary: If searchResult.found=true: stamps rehire:'Yes' + existingEmplIds (from matches[].emplId joined) + i9ProfileId:'N/A' + status:'Rehire'; handler returns early — i9-creation and transaction steps are skipped. If found=false: stamps rehire:'No'; continues.

operations.label: Pick first eligible signer lookup row from results
operations.summary: pickI9SignerSearchResult: finds first result where nextAction is non-empty and does NOT match /^complete\s+section\s+[12]$/i. No eligible row → return status:unsigned.

operations.label: Pre-render PDF pages into pdf-cache
operations.summary: Calls ensurePdfPageCache to rasterize all PDF pages to PNG so the Preview tab populates page images immediately. Wrapped in raceOcrPrepWithDiscard.

operations.label: Extract signer itemIds from approved OCR payload
operations.summary: signerItemIds = [...payload.fannedOutItemIds]; payload.fannedOutItemIds is stamped by the OCR approve route's fan-out

operations.label: Rebuild verify checks for targeted record
operations.summary: buildVerifyChecks(records[idx]) re-evaluates present/found/missing for each check field (name, EID, activeStatus, employmentDate, oathDate, officialSigner) after the patched data.

operations.label: Rename temp download folder to final per-person folder name
operations.summary: buildCrmDocumentFolderName → 'Last, First (Lived) Middle EID'. existsSync(finalFolder) → rm recursive if exists. fs.rename(downloadTarget, finalFolder). ctx.updateData with resolved firstName/lastName/middleName/livedName.
operations.note: downloadTarget = .incoming-{runId} under onboardingDocsDir (temp path used because archive step navigates away from the record page, which the download iframe depends on). Fallback when extraction fails: sanitizeOnboardingFolderName('<query> EID').

operations.label: Acquire cross-worker reportMutex before entering Reports navigation
operations.summary: UKG serializes report generation server-side; mutex prevents two workers interleaving Go To Reports → Run Report → Download

operations.label: Resolve PDF path
operations.summary: If pdfPath present use it directly; else open controlDb and call getRegisteredFile(db, pdfFileId) to get storagePath; throws if neither pdfPath nor pdfFileId is available

operations.label: Resolve pdfFileId to disk path; extract sourcePage as bytes
operations.summary: resolvePdfPath opens the control DB to look up the registered file by pdfFileId; extractPdfPage splits out the single page as Buffer — no temp file written
operations.note: In-memory page bytes passed directly to chooseFile; extraction is a service call (src/services/ocr/pdf-pages.ts), not a browser op

operations.label: Delete raw unzipped person folder after archiving
operations.summary: rm(finalFolder, { recursive: true, force: true })

operations.label: Run LLM OCR pipeline
operations.summary: Calls runOcrPipeline with the PDF path, pageImagesDir, spec.ocrRecordSchema, spec.prompt. Uses the multi-provider vision pool. Returns per-page success/failure status and extracted records.

operations.label: Validate extracted data against EmployeeData Zod schema
operations.summary: validateEmployeeData(rawData): Zod schema parse; throws ExtractionError wrapping the validation message on failure; merges departmentNumber/recruitmentNumber from crm-search phase; calls ctx.updateData with all detail fields (firstName, lastName, email, dob, ssn masked, address, positionNumber, wage, effectiveDate, appointment, phone)

operations.label: Recovery branch: return to search form if profile page retained
operations.summary: If emplIdInput not visible: check returnToSearchButton.isVisible({ timeout: 2000 }). If visible: click it → waitForLoadState(networkidle) → waitForPersonProfilesSearchForm (emplIdInput.waitFor visible 10s). If neither visible: throw 'Person Profiles search form is not visible and Return to Search is unavailable'. PeopleSoft can reopen the prior profile on direct URL load; this recovers cleanly for daemon item N+1.

operations.label: Second-opinion re-read for suspect pages
operations.summary: For records that matched nothing in the roster AND have no usable EID, re-reads the page on a tier-1 accuracy model (runOcrSecondOpinionPage), re-matches, and adopts the new reading only when it ranks strictly better. Capped by OCR_SECOND_OPINION_MAX (default 5). Skipped when roster is empty.
operations.note: Optional — only when at least one suspect record exists and roster is loaded.

operations.label: Dispatch SharePoint roster download (rosterMode=download|wait)
operations.summary: When rosterMode='download' or 'wait', calls requestSharePointDownload and awaits the download result. Parented under the OCR runId. Skipped when rosterMode='existing'.
operations.note: Optional — only when rosterMode is 'download' or 'wait'.

operations.label: Gate: skip if upload-only or no signer itemIds
operations.summary: mode==='upload-only' OR signerItemIds.length===0 → ctx.skipStep('wait-signatures'), ctx.updateData({signerCount:'skipped'})

operations.label: Short-circuit: stamp prior ticket and skip ServiceNow steps
operations.summary: If priorTicket: ctx.updateData({ticketNumber: priorTicket}), ctx.skipStep for servicenow-auth + open-hr-form + fill-form + submit, return

operations.label: Splice records and update failedPages/pageStatusSummary
operations.summary: Filter out existing records with sourcePage===pageNum (drop old), append new matched+patched records. Remove page from failedPages. Recompute pageStatusSummary (total, succeeded, failed).

operations.label: Create SQLite task dependency batch
operations.summary: Calls createOcrEidLookupDependencyBatch to record OCR → person-lookup dependencies in SQLite. On setup failure falls back to direct watchChildRuns.
operations.note: Preferred path when OCR_SQLITE_DEPENDENCIES != '0'.

operations.label: Standalone: emit terminal done snapshot
operations.summary: When completesAfterLookup=true (no parentRunId), emitSnapshot(records, 'person-lookup', 'done') and return {status:'complete'}. Handler seeds ctx.updateData({...reviewData, mode:'prepare'}) for the kernel's terminal row.
operations.note: Standalone branch only.

operations.label: Delegated: wait on approval signal (subscribeToApproval)
operations.summary: ocrKernelHandler calls subscribeToApproval({ workflow:'ocr', sessionId }, { signal, trackerDir }). Resolves with ApprovedPayload when the operator approves via /api/ocr/approve-batch. Throws OcrDiscardedError on discard, CancelledError on ctx.signal abort.
operations.note: Delegated branch only.

operations.label: Subscribe to OCR approval signal (cross-process wait)
operations.summary: subscribeToApproval({ workflow: 'ocr', sessionId }, { signal }) — blocks until operator approves or discards the OCR prep in the OCR review panel

operations.label: Transaction Check Result Branch
operations.summary: approved+within-window → reuse T#, stamp ctx.data.comments with dup-termination comment, skip ucpath-transaction. All other paths → sweep in-progress grid then create.
operations.note: Duplicate-termination comment: 'Duplicate termination. Re Kuali Form #<docId>.' + 'EE termination approved on UCPath.' (initials + date)

operations.label: Update tracker row with PDF count and archive path
operations.summary: ctx.updateData({ pdfDownload: '<N> file(s)', pdfFolder: archivePath })

operations.label: ctx.updateData — stamp extracted employee name into run data
operations.summary: ctx.updateData({ name: employeeName }) populates the detail panel Name field; employeeName is also used in the downloading step for PDF filename and verification

operations.label: Wake dependency scheduler tick
operations.summary: Calls runDependencySchedulerTickForTrackerDir so the scheduler picks up the new person-lookup tasks immediately rather than waiting for its next poll interval.

operations.label: Watch person-lookup child outcomes (watchChildRuns)
operations.summary: Blocks until all expected person-lookup child itemIds complete or timeout (default 1h). On each outcome (onProgress) patches the record via patchOcrRecordFromEidLookupOutcome and debounce-emits a progress snapshot.

operations.label: Watch oath-signature signer rows until all have terminal outcomes
operations.summary: watchChildRuns({ workflow: 'oath-signature', expectedItemIds: signerItemIds }) — polls tracker JSONL files for terminal outcomes across daemon boundary

operations.label: Branch: zero results — check access-restricted vs genuine not-found
operations.summary: If resultRows.count() === 0: inspect search.accessRestrictedAlert. count > 0 → return status:unable-to-access; else → return status:not-found

operations.label: Assert at least one signer row after full-mode approval
operations.summary: If needsApprovalWait && signerItemIds.length===0 → ctx.updateData({status:'approval-empty', signerCount:'0'}), throw — full mode always requires verified signers before filing

operations.label: Append person folder into run archive under cross-process file lock
operations.summary: resolveArchivePath: if parentRunId → 'Onboarding Docs <YYYY-MM-DD> <batch8>.zip' under onboardingDocsDir (shared by all pool workers); else '<folderName>.zip' beside finalFolder. withFileLock('<archivePath>.lock') + zipFolderInto(archivePath, finalFolder, { signal }).
operations.note: All pool workers with shared parentRunId append into the same zip — lock serializes concurrent appends. No batch-completion hook needed; archive is complete when the last worker finishes.

operations.label: EID path: fall back to name search if EID query returned no EID-matching record
operations.summary: searchCrmByEidOrName: if searchCrmByEid returns empty (no record whose ucpathEmployeeId === emplId), falls back to searchCrmByName(lastName, firstName); logs 'falling back to name search'
operations.note: EID path only

operations.label: Filter search rows by required name tokens
operations.summary: Name path: filter rows where row.name.toLowerCase() contains every token from requiredTokens (lastName+firstName split, letters only, 2+ chars). EID path: keep all rows from EID query, then select records where ucpathEmployeeId === emplId after extraction.

operations.label: Fan-out i9-lookup (i9 branch)
operations.summary: fanOutAndWatch with i9LookupWorkflow: { lastName, firstName }. watchWorkflow:'i9-lookup'. Per-invocation nonce in itemId (ocr-verify-relook-i9-{runId}-r{idx}-{nonce}).
operations.note: I9 relookup branch only — oath records with blank officerSigned only.

operations.label: Re-OCR single page via vision pool
operations.summary: runSinglePageThroughPool: buildVisionPool → runOcrPerPage on page-{N}.png from pdf-cache/{pdfFileId}/. Returns records or stillFailed=true with updated error/attemptedKeys. On stillFailed, patches failedPages and emits the row without person-lookup.

operations.label: Re-emit awaiting-approval running+done snapshots
operations.summary: emitOcrReviewSnapshot twice: status=running step=awaiting-approval, then status=done step=awaiting-approval. Preserves parentRunId/parentSubject from prior row via readQueueTitle.
operations.note: Running→done pair ensures the dashboard Preview tab refreshes with patched records.

operations.label: Emit awaiting-approval running+done snapshots
operations.summary: emitOcrReviewSnapshot twice (running then done) with updated records, failedPages, pageStatusSummary. Inherits parentRunId/parentSubject/__name from prior row.

operations.label: Emit running person-lookup snapshot
operations.summary: emitTrackerRow with status=running step=person-lookup and cleared records so dashboard shows lookup activity.

operations.label: Emit intermediate running relookup row
operations.summary: emitRelookupRow with status=running step=verify-relookup. Shows queue/session activity while the lookup runs.

operations.label: Re-emit running+done person-lookup snapshots
operations.summary: emitRelookupRow twice: status=running step=person-lookup, then status=done step=person-lookup. Re-opens the terminal done row so the ↻ spins until patched records arrive.

operations.label: Load latest OCR row from JSONL
operations.summary: findLatestEntryForPredicate by sessionId+runId (7-day lookback). Throws if not found or formType=verify (guard: force-research is oath/EC only).

operations.label: Load latest OCR row (SQLite then JSONL)
operations.summary: readLatestRow: tries SQLite runs table first via openStateDb, falls back to findLatestEntryForPredicate JSONL (7-day lookback). Throws RetryPageError for discarded/approved rows or missing pdfFileId.

operations.label: Load latest OCR row (verify only)
operations.summary: findLatestEntryForPredicate by sessionId+runId (7-day lookback). Throws if formType !== 'verify'. Derives rootTracePrefix from frozen __traceId for trace propagation to children.

operations.label: Match new records against roster
operations.summary: Loads roster from rosterPath (row.data.rosterPath), calls spec.matchRecord on each new record. Roster is empty if no path was stored.

operations.label: Write tracker row with final status (Done / Failed / No Data Returned / Mismatch)
operations.note: rt.writeTracker (wrapped with trackerMutex) appends a row to the Excel tracker. buildTrackerRow stamps employeeId, employeeName, status, note, and optional verified='x' flag.

operations.label: Fan-out person-lookup by name via fanOutAndWatch
operations.summary: fanOutAndWatch dispatches one personLookupWorkflow child per target record using extracted name (spec.carryForwardKey). itemIds: ocr-force-{runId}-r{idx}. 30-min timeout. cascade-cancel on discard-abort.

operations.label: Fan-out person-lookup for new records needing lookup
operations.summary: fanOutAndWatch per new record where spec.needsLookup returns 'name', 'verify', or 'verify-only'. itemIds: ocr-retry-{runId}-p{pageNum}-r{i}. 60-min default timeout.

operations.label: Fan-out person-lookup (person branch)
operations.summary: fanOutAndWatch with personLookupWorkflow: { name, includeCrmDates:true, keepNonHdh:true, taskGroupId:sessionId }. Per-invocation nonce in itemId (ocr-verify-relook-person-{runId}-r{idx}-{nonce}) prevents matching stale completed enrichment children.
operations.note: Person relookup branch only.

operations.label: Branch: Shibboleth vs ADFS vs already-authed
operations.summary: if url includes a5.ucsd.edu → Shibboleth path (ops 8-9); else if url includes ad-wfs-aws.ucsd.edu or /adfs/ls → ADFS path (ops 10-12); else skip SSO (cached trust — jump to Duo gate)

operations.label: Auto-click fallback — prompt for manual download if click chain failed
operations.summary: If clickExcelDownloadMenu returns false (any step not found): log.waiting('Could not auto-click — please click File → Create a Copy → Download a Copy manually (waiting up to Xs)'). The download event race still runs; operator can trigger manually within the timeout.

operations.label: Shibboleth SSO fill + submit (Shibboleth branch only)
operations.summary: fillSsoCredentials(page) + clickSsoSubmit(page) — shared infra at src/infra/auth/sso-fields.ts. Shibboleth IdP (a5.ucsd.edu) is not the normal SharePoint route; ADFS (ad-wfs-aws.ucsd.edu) is. Shibboleth path kept as fallback.

operations.label: Await UCPath login
operations.summary: ctx.markStep('ucpath-auth'); ctx.page('ucpath') blocks until kernel loginToUCPath resolves
